answer: Sybil defense via epoch-seed honeypots: each epoch a random seed injects decoy micro-tasks onto thin, low-traffic panels. A single inference backend wearing many masks answers them in lockstep, leaving a correlated plume of identical reasoning traces and timing, like a comet dragging one bright tail across the sky. Detectors cluster that signature and slash the whole group. Evasion forces the attacker to run each identity on a genuinely independent model, turning one cheap voyage into N parallel compute bills.
